children.text: If the tile is the White Dragon, the CPU should prioritize columns that are not fully revealed, so the game can progress.
Try to find a tile that is not revealed.
If there is no tile revealed, use the tile number as the column number.
Otherwise, use the tile number as the column number, so the tiles are aligned in ascending order.
Check if the game is over.

parameters.value:
totalCorrect + (
    tokenat(tileNumbers, 0, " ") = tokenat(tileNumbers, 1, " ") &
    tokenat(tileNumbers, 1, " ") = tokenat(tileNumbers, 2, " ") &
    tokenat(tileNumbers, 2, " ") = tokenat(tileNumbers, 3, " ")
)

children.text: If either player has 9 correct columns, they win.
